transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I just… I can’t sleep right anymore. It’s all broken up, and it’s starting to feel like I’m not functioning. I work overnights, so you’d think when I get off a shift I’d be exhausted enough to just pass out, but I’ll get home and lie there wide awake, staring at nothing, like my body is tired but my mind won’t let me rest.

And then when I finally do drift off, it’s not real sleep. I keep waking up scared, like something’s wrong, and I don’t even feel like I slept. I wake up feeling just as tired as before, maybe worse. It’s been really hard, and I didn’t know what else to do.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried around the time you’re trying to fall asleep or during the night when you wake up?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t know if it’s exactly worry like I’m thinking through one specific thing, but when I’m trying to fall asleep my mind just won’t settle. I’ll get off an overnight shift and I know I should be exhausted, like my whole body feels drained, but then I’m lying there wide awake and tense, staring at the room, and it feels like something is wrong even if I can’t explain what.

And when I do finally drift off, it doesn’t last. I’ll wake up scared, like startled or with this heavy feeling, and then I’m just up again. It’s not restful sleep at all. It’s like I never actually slept, just closed my eyes for pieces of time and came back feeling worse.
Have you noticed yourself feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy, even when you’re not trying to sleep?

Yeah… yes. It’s not just at night. It’s kind of there all the time now, like as soon as I open my eyes, before I even sit up, I already feel this heaviness on me. Not just tired, but empty. Like there’s nothing in me to start the day with.

I used to be the kind of person who went to church, and I liked Zumba, and I used to help with the kids at the center, and that felt like me, you know? Like I had a place and I could show up for people. Now it feels like that person is just… gone somewhere. I don’t feel connected to any of it the same way. Even thinking about doing those things feels far away, like I’m remembering somebody else’s life.

Most days I’m just low from the start, and it doesn’t really lift. I keep trying to tell myself maybe I’m just worn out, but it feels deeper than that. Like I’m moving around with this weight in my chest and I can’t get back to who I was.
How long have you been feeling this way — this heaviness, loss of interest, and trouble sleeping — have these been with you every day, most days, or off and on?

It’s been… a long time now. I’d say about a year and two months. It didn’t just happen one bad week and go away. It started around when my agency changed my schedule, when they put me on those rotating overnight shifts and then added all this extra paperwork on top of it.

At first I thought it was just me adjusting, like maybe my body was confused from sleeping at weird times, and I kept telling myself, “Just get through this schedule, you’ll get used to it.” But it didn’t really settle. The sleep got worse, and then the heaviness and not wanting to do anything kind of stayed with it. Most days it’s there. It feels like it’s been following me since that change, like everything got thrown off and I never got back to normal.
Have you ever felt this way before — with low mood and trouble sleeping — or is this the first time you've experienced something like this?

I’m not totally sure how to answer that, because I mean… I’ve had bad times before. Everybody has, right? I’ve had nights where I didn’t sleep well, or times I felt sad or stressed, especially when life was hard or work was a lot. But this… this feels different from what I remember.

I don’t know if I can say it’s the first time I’ve ever felt low, because that wouldn’t be honest. But the way it’s been stuck to me, day after day, and the way the sleep has been so messed up with it… I don’t remember going through something quite like this before. Not for this long, and not where it felt like it took over everything.

So I guess… I don’t know. I’ve had rough periods, but this feels like the first time it’s been this heavy and hard to shake.

Before this current period that started about a year and two months ago, have you ever had a time when you felt down nearly every day and lost interest in things for at least two weeks in a row — something that might have been a major depressive episode?

I don’t really know. I’ve been trying to think back, but it’s hard to separate regular hard times from… from something like what you’re asking.

Before this started, I know I had times I was sad or stressed, and maybe I pulled back some, but I can’t clearly remember a stretch where it was nearly every day for two weeks and I stopped caring about things the way I have now. If it happened, I didn’t think of it that way at the time. I probably would have just said I was tired or overwhelmed.

So I guess my honest answer is I’m not sure. I don’t have a clear memory of a time before this that was like this.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this current one — even if it was brief — where you felt down most days, lost interest in things, and it felt like more than just normal sadness?

I mean… before this, not really in the same way. I keep trying to compare it, but what’s happening now feels like it swallowed up who I was.

Most days now, it’s like I open my eyes and that heaviness is already there. I don’t even get a minute where I feel normal first. It’s just this empty feeling, like there’s this weight sitting on me before I even get out of bed. And I think about how I used to be the person who went to church, who would go to Zumba, who cared about helping with the kids at the center, and now it feels like that person is just… gone. Like I can remember her, but I can’t get back to her.

So if you’re asking if I had sadness before, yes, I had sad times. But this feeling of being heavy and empty most days, and losing the part of me that wanted to show up for those things… I don’t remember that happening before like this.

Can you think back to any time before this current period — even years ago — when you felt this same kind of heaviness and loss of interest for a while, and then it went away completely before coming back again?

I’ve been trying to think back, even to years ago, and… no, I don’t think I can point to a time where it was this same thing and then it completely went away and came back.

I’ve had sad stretches before, like I said, but not this kind of heaviness. Not where most days I wake up and it’s already there, like before I even get my feet on the floor I feel empty. It’s hard to explain, because it’s not just being upset about something. It feels like something in me got turned off.

Before, even if I was having a bad time, I still felt like me underneath it. I still was the person who would go to church, or go to Zumba, or help with the kids at the center. I might have been tired or stressed, but that part of me was still there. Now it feels like that person is gone, or far away, and I’m just remembering her instead of being her.

So I don’t remember this happening before, going away completely, and then returning. This feels like the first time it’s been this heavy and taken over this much.

Can you think back to any time before this current period — even if it was years ago — when you felt this same kind of heaviness and loss of interest, and then it went away completely for a while before coming back again?

I know I keep coming back to the same thing, but no… I really can’t think of another time before this where it felt like this, then went away, and then came back.

I’ve had times where I was sad or worn down, but this heaviness now is different. Most days I open my eyes and it’s already there, like I don’t even get a chance to feel like myself first. It’s just this empty, heavy feeling sitting on me right away.

And the part that scares me is how it feels like the person I used to be is gone. Like the woman who went to church, who went to Zumba, who helped with the kids at the center — I can remember doing those things, but it feels far away, like I’m talking about someone else. I don’t remember ever losing myself like that before and then getting better for a while. This feels like the first time it’s taken over like this.

Can you think back to any time before this current period — even if it was years ago — when you felt this same kind of heaviness and loss of interest, and then it went away completely for at least a few weeks or months before coming back again?

I know you’re asking if there was another episode before this one, where it got bad like this and then lifted for weeks or months… and I’m trying to be honest, but I really can’t think of a time like that.

This heaviness now is what stands out to me. Most days, it’s there the second I open my eyes. It’s not like I wake up okay and then remember things and get sad — it’s already sitting on me, like this empty weight. And then I think about who I used to be, like going to church, going to Zumba, helping with the kids at the center… those used to feel like parts of me. Now it feels like that person is just gone, like I can picture her doing those things but I don’t feel connected to her.

I’ve had normal sad times before, but I don’t remember ever feeling this heavy and empty, losing interest like this, and then having it go away completely for a while before coming back. This feels like the first time it’s been like this.
